nameOverride.description: Replace chart name in resource names and labels.

resources.description: Gateway container CPU and memory requests and limits.

extraArgs.description: Arguments appended after chart-managed gateway flags.

extraEnv.description: Additional Kubernetes EnvVar entries for the gateway.

image.description: Policy-service image, also used by the init container.

pullPolicy.description: Policy-service and init-container image pull policy.

httpPort.description: Loopback HTTP port for readiness and JWKS.

httpTokenSecret.description: Existing Secret with `token` for protected HTTP routes.

resources.description: Policy-service container CPU and memory requests and limits.

extraArgs.description: Arguments appended after chart-managed service flags.

extraEnv.description: Additional Kubernetes EnvVar entries for the service.

gatewayEndpoint.description: Optional OpenShell gateway URL for APF callbacks.

allowInsecureTransport.description: Disable interceptor TLS for isolated local development only.

url.description: Signed tarball URL; required in HTTP mode.

tokenSecret.description: Optional existing bearer-token Secret for the HTTP source.

tarGz.description: Signed tarball bytes supplied through `--set-file` in local mode.

file.description: Signed tarball path packaged inside the chart in local mode.

existingConfigMap.description: Existing local tarball ConfigMap; set to `""` for `tarGz` or `file`.

tarKey.description: Tarball key in the local ConfigMap.

manifest.description: Manifest path inside the extracted local bundle.

rolloutRevision.description: Change to restart the pod after external Secret or trust updates.

existingConfigMap.description: Existing public trust-key ConfigMap; set to `""` to use `trustRoot.keys`.

keys.description: Public signing keys indexed by key ID for a chart-managed ConfigMap.

keyFile.description: Signing seed key in that Secret.

keyId.description: Key ID attached to signed documents.

surfaces.description: Policy projection surfaces requested from the service.

tier.description: `1` for admission; `2` also exposes supervisor middleware.

port.description: Tier-2 middleware Service and container port.

tlsSecret.description: Existing Secret with middleware TLS files and `trust.toml`; required at tier 2.

persistence.description: Use a PVC for antirollback counters; otherwise `emptyDir`.

storageClass.description: State PVC StorageClass; empty uses cluster default.

persistence.description: Use a PVC for audit files; otherwise `emptyDir`.

size.description: Audit PVC capacity request when enabled.

storageClass.description: Audit PVC StorageClass; empty uses cluster default.

mountPath.description: Audit directory mounted in both containers.

openshift.description: Let OpenShift assign UID and fsGroup instead of setting explicit IDs.

runAsUser.description: Pod user ID when `openshift` is false.

runAsGroup.description: Pod group ID when `openshift` is false.

fsGroup.description: Pod filesystem group when `openshift` is false.

imagePullSecrets.description: Existing Kubernetes image pull Secret references.

extraVolumes.description: Additional pod volumes for custom configuration.
